verified: source lock prevents an inconsistent competing backup
deterministic exact-byte archive preserves snapshots, pending and nested recovery evidence
existing archives, missing sources and unsupported source evidence fail without replacement or bootstrap
corrupt, truncated and trailing archive bytes reject before destination creation
restore refuses existing empty directories and files
restored approvals, conversion exports and original receipts reopen unchanged; pending still blocks next write
preserved pending quarantine then exact retry commits once and survives another complete backup/restore
